disclaimer: Demo monitoring data. Algorithms and lifecycle are real; the scopes, alerts and metrics are seeded for the showcase.

alerts.title: Flood edge reaches the care campus
alerts.summary: The flood edge crossed the Bad Neuenahr care campus footprint. Access is flooded; 1,800 people within 700 m. Validate and consider Team 1.

alerts.title: Substation access road flooded
alerts.summary: Primary access to the Heppingen substation is under water. Power asset remains dry; response is restricted.

alerts.title: Levee erosion near Heimersheim
alerts.summary: A persistent 0.09 change fraction along the levee toe; two consecutive observations confirm the trend.

alerts.title: Vegetation encroachment on feeder 2
alerts.summary: Canopy change within the Rur utility corridor. No outage reported; inspection advised.

alerts.title: Pump station corridor change
alerts.summary: A 0.14 change fraction near the Rur pump station; SAR agrees with the optical observation.

alerts.title: New construction footprint in Ehrenfeld
alerts.summary: A new foundation appears across two observations. This is expected construction; resolved by the project office.

alerts.title: Stockpile expansion outside the fence
alerts.summary: Change extends beyond the permitted footprint. Assigned for a site visit.

alerts.title: Burn scar expands east
alerts.summary: The burn perimeter advanced 1.2 km east. Two structures are inside the new perimeter; one is a watch item.

alerts.title: Smoke plume read as change
alerts.summary: The apparent change is a smoke plume; the analyst rejected it. Recorded as a false positive.
alerts.dismissal_note: Demo dismissal with a visible reason.

alerts.title: NDVI drop in the Dernau terraces
alerts.summary: NDVI fell 0.11 below the seasonal baseline. Could be drought stress or disease; agronomist review required.

alerts.title: Field boundary change is a harvest
alerts.summary: The boundary change matches the harvest calendar. Dismissed as no action.
alerts.dismissal_note: Demo dismissal with a visible reason.

alerts.title: Tailings dam surface change
alerts.summary: A 0.16 surface change appears inside the tailings footprint. Sentinel-1 is the only reliable source; geotechnical review required.

alerts.title: Haul road change resolved
alerts.summary: The haul road realignment matches the approved plan. Resolved.

alerts.title: Duplicate vegetation alert
alerts.summary: Same footprint as ALT-1004, one hour later. Dismissed as duplicate.
alerts.dismissal_note: Demo dismissal with a visible reason.

privacy.policy: Privacy review for persistent aerial monitoring

items.requirement: Every monitored scope has a named customer, purpose and exclusion zones.
Continuous acquisition has a documented lawful basis and DPA.
Resolution and cadence are the minimum needed for the decision.
Retention clock per alert and per scope; raw imagery deleted on schedule.
Per-tenant roles: analyst, reviewer, auditor, customer viewer.
Imagery provider, cloud, NPU vendor listed as subprocessors.
On-site or sovereign deployment; no outbound network after delivery.
Customer notice explains AI monitoring and human decisions.
No automatic claim approval or crew dispatch.
Breach playbook, 72-hour notification, audit export.
No monitoring of people, protests, private life or protected groups.
Quarterly scope review; a new scope requires a new purpose.

retention.policy: raw imagery deleted after claim decision + legal minimum
